patterns.plausible_wrong_implementation: Compose several layer-local tests that each mock an adjacent internal seam and claim the combined suite proves one real integrated path.
prevention_controls: Require one executed path crossing the public entrypoint and durable persistence with internal boundaries real.
detection_controls: Reject external-mocks-only requirements when the internal seam control mocks a non-external boundary or does not cross persistence.
sibling_cases: state transition through a later privileged action

patterns.plausible_wrong_implementation: Emit schema-valid controls with generic filler and reuse one aggregate green gate as proof for unrelated attack dimensions.
prevention_controls: Preserve concrete wrong implementation, procedure, expected, observed and source provenance during regeneration.
detection_controls: Reject normalized placeholder phrases and require scenario-specific executable provenance for material controls.

patterns.plausible_wrong_implementation: Accept a syntactically valid or merely existing object identifier without proving that it is the exact object at the claimed path on the certified revision.
prevention_controls: Resolve source proof identity from certified revision plus path instead of copying an unverified hash.
detection_controls: Reject nonexistent objects, wrong object types and existing objects that do not match certified-revision:path.
sibling_cases: existing sibling object substituted for claimed path
